stands_for: What the reader found it could not tell from cv-generic/2026-08-30_cv_FR.pdf, cv-archive/2022/leCVWeb.docx and cv-archive/2025/CV-2025.pdf: one question per kind, each standing on a real fact of those documents, and a fifth candidate of a kind that is not one of the three, which the run drops and never stores.
